data.name: REDHOOD: CONTRACT ASSAULT ACTION
data.detailed_description:
REDHOOD: CONTRACT ASSAULT ACTION

A former soldier drowning in debt receives a message from an unknown sender.

No name. No explanation. Just a contract.

Hunt down four targets. Get paid. Get out.

Each operation drops you into a different location filled with armed criminals, civilians, and unpredictable situations. Your targets change every run. Their locations change. Your extraction point changes. Nothing is guaranteed.

Complete contracts, earn cash, unlock new equipment, and survive long enough to uncover who is behind the messages.

Features:

• Different contracts with 4 random targets every run
• Random extraction scenarios and escape routes
• Multiple locations including subway stations, restaurants, apartments, warehouses, clubs, and more
• Fast-paced low-poly PS2-inspired action and early 2000s PC Games
• Brutal firefights where every second matters

You weren't chosen because you're special.

You were chosen because you're expendable.

Over 200 random mission combinations on each map!

  • 4 target groups

  • Each group has 3 possible targets

  • At mission start, 1 target from each group is chosen

  • Target locations are fixed

  • 1 extraction point from 3 is chosen

data.short_description: A desperate ex-soldier accepts deadly contracts from an anonymous employer. Hunt 4 random targets, fight through hostile locations, and reach a random extraction point in this fast-paced PS2-inspired and early 2000s PC Games shooter.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1650 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent violence, gun combat, blood effects, and depictions of criminal activity. Players can engage in firefights against armed enemies and may harm civilian characters. Some levels contain mature themes and environments such as nightclubs, bars, and criminal hideouts. The game does not contain explicit sexual content or graphic dismemberment.
